en: Build a career with direction
Turn scattered work into a portfolio of decisions, outcomes and lessons.
Document one project each week.
Write the story behind a recent technical decision.
zh: 让职业成长更有方向
把零散的工作积累成作品集，记录做过的决定、实际结果与学到的经验。
每周整理一个项目案例。
写清最近一次技术选择背后的思考。

en: A healthier, sustainable rhythm
Build a routine around three workouts a week, consistent sleep and time to recover.
Keep the routine achievable on busy days.
Review energy and sleep before increasing training.
zh: 建立可持续的健康节奏
围绕每周三次运动、规律睡眠与充分恢复，建立忙碌时也能坚持的习惯。
把计划缩小到忙碌时也做得到。
先回顾精力和睡眠，再考虑增加训练量。

en: Learn by making something useful
Connect reading about AI with small experiments and reusable notes.
One useful experiment matters more than ten unfinished courses.
Build a small prototype and record what changed your understanding.
zh: 通过做出东西来学习
把 AI 阅读、动手实验与知识笔记连接起来，让学习留下可复用的成果。
完成一个有用的小实验，比同时开十门课程更重要。
做一个小原型，记录它如何改变了自己的理解。

en: Make room for meaningful connection
Protect a weekly evening for family and friends, with fewer distractions and better conversations.
Listen before trying to solve the problem.
Plan one unhurried conversation this week.
zh: 给重要的关系留出时间
每周为家人与朋友留出一段不被打扰的时间，少一点分心，多一点交流。
先理解对方，再尝试解决问题。
这周安排一次不赶时间的交流。

en: A personal knowledge base that grows
Bring useful ideas from daily AI conversations into one source-linked place.
Separate lasting insight from temporary requests.
Review new knowledge and keep the next action clear.
zh: 让个人知识库持续生长
把日常 AI 对话中的有用信息整理到同一个地方，保留来处，形成自己的积累。
把长期认知与临时请求分开。
回顾新知识，让下一步行动保持清晰。

en: Product engineer
I work as a product engineer and enjoy turning ideas into useful tools.
zh: 产品工程师
我是一名产品工程师，喜欢把想法做成有用的工具。

en: Learning about AI systems
I am learning how AI systems can support everyday work and personal reflection.
zh: 持续学习 AI 系统
我正在学习 AI 系统如何帮助日常工作与个人复盘。

en: Running and strength training
Running and strength training are part of my regular routine.
zh: 跑步与力量训练
跑步和力量训练是我日常生活的一部分。

en: Concise, actionable work updates
For work updates, I prefer concise explanations with a clear next action.
zh: 简洁、可行动的工作沟通
在工作沟通中，我偏好简洁的说明，以及清楚的下一步行动。

en: Learn through small projects
I prefer learning by building small projects rather than only collecting courses.
zh: 用小项目推动学习
我偏好通过做小项目来学习，而不是只收藏课程。

en: Consistency over intensity
I prefer sustainable exercise routines over short bursts of extreme intensity.
zh: 持续性优先于强度
运动计划上，我更重视可以持续的节奏，而不是短期追求极高强度。

en: A quiet weekly review
I prefer a quiet weekly review to connect daily choices with longer-term goals.
zh: 每周安静地复盘一次
我喜欢每周安静地复盘一次，把日常选择与长期目标连接起来。

en: Make the next step small enough
A habit becomes more reliable when its minimum version still fits a busy day.
zh: 让下一步小到可以开始
当一个习惯的最小版本在忙碌时也能完成，它就更容易持续。

en: Separate evidence from assumptions
Before changing a plan, distinguish observed results from explanations that have not been tested.
zh: 把事实与假设分开
调整计划之前，先分清已经观察到的结果与还没有验证的解释。

en: Keep the reasoning, not just the answer
A reusable note explains why a decision worked and when the same approach may apply.
zh: 记录推理，而不只是答案
可复用的笔记应说明一个选择为什么有效，以及什么时候可以再次使用。

en: Understand before offering solutions
In a difficult conversation, clarify what the other person needs before offering a solution.
zh: 先理解，再给出建议
在困难的交流里，先理解对方需要什么，再给出解决方案。

en: Review turns information into direction
A weekly review is useful when it ends with a small number of clear next actions.
zh: 复盘让信息变成方向
每周复盘的价值，在于最后形成少量清晰、可以执行的下一步行动。

en: Changed the training plan
Replaced daily workouts with three sessions per week to make room for recovery.
zh: 调整了运动计划
从每天训练改为每周三次，为恢复留出空间。

en: Finished a first small prototype
Completed a small AI-assisted prototype and documented the trade-offs.
zh: 完成了第一个小原型
完成了一个 AI 辅助的小原型，并记录了设计中的取舍。

en: Started a weekly connection ritual
Set aside one evening each week for an unhurried conversation with family or friends.
zh: 开始每周的交流习惯
每周留出一个晚上，与家人或朋友进行一次不赶时间的交流。

en: Started keeping a personal knowledge base
Moved from scattered chat history to organized notes with links to their sources.
zh: 开始积累自己的知识库
从散落的聊天记录，转向分类整理并保留来源的个人笔记。
